description: Community Sopro V2 Turbo (samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo): a 120M zero-shot voice-cloning TTS. SentencePiece text tokenizer, style-prefix conditioned autoregressive semantic LM over FSQ tokens, rectified-flow acoustic DiT and a Vocos ISTFT vocoder at 24 kHz.

request.name: language
request.description: Language tag prepended to the prompt (en, pt, fr, de). Optional; helps pronunciation on ambiguous text.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus sampling threshold for the semantic LM; default 0.9.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k truncation for the semantic LM; 0 disables. Default 25.

request.name: max_seconds
request.description: Cap on generated audio per segment; long text is split into segments so total length is unbounded. Default 30.

request.name: min_seconds
request.description: Minimum audio per segment before the semantic LM may emit EOS; default 0.4.

request.name: ref_seconds
request.description: Reference audio window used for cloning; default 10.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum codepoints per synthesis segment; default 300 (config.json generation.max_segment_chars).

request.name: seed
request.description: Non-negative seed for semantic sampling and the acoustic noise prior; omit for a random seed.

session.name: language
session.description: Default language tag for requests that do not set one.

load.name: matmul_weight_type
load.description: Storage type for the matmul weights of every stage (semantic LM, acoustic DiT, encoders, vocoder head).

load.name: conv_weight_type
load.description: Storage type for convolution weights (speaker/semantic encoders and the Vocos backbone).

download.reason: No audio.cpp GGUF build of sopro-v2-turbo is published yet: install the sopro_v2_turbo_safetensors package and run from safetensors, or pack one locally with audiocpp_gguf (one --input namespace per stage: model, semantic_encoder, speaker_encoder, vocoder).

packages.description: Locally packed GGUF holding all four stages plus the embedded config and tokenizer sidecars. Produced with audiocpp_gguf --family sopro_tts.
Upstream checkpoint from samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo: config.json, tokenizer.model and the four safetensors stages. Runs directly, no conversion needed.
